items.title: OpenAI verliert zweiten Führungskreismitglied in einer Woche
items.summary: OpenAI's Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser announced she is leaving the company, just two days after COO Brad Lightcap said he would depart. It is the second senior exit in a week, raising questions about organizational stability at one of the most influential AI labs.

items.title: Microsoft 合并 Copilot 应用，为‘超级应用’铺路
items.summary: Microsoft announced it is merging its Copilot apps into a single unified experience ahead of an eventual 'super app.' The move gets rid of the annoying double-Copilot icons and signals Microsoft's ambition to make Copilot the central AI assistant across Windows, Office, and Edge.

items.title: Microsoft 的 Copilot 拟人形象 Mico 退役
items.summary: Microsoft retired Mico, the Clippy-like animated character that served as the face of Copilot's voice mode, less than a year after launch. Mico is being moved to a 'Learn Live' education context; the change reflects Microsoft's shift from a playful character-driven AI toward a more utilitarian assistant.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4 Pro 公开，开源模型再上新台阶
items.summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, a new open-weight frontier model. The LLM stats tracker lists it alongside Gemini 3.7 Flash and other recent releases, showing that Chinese labs continue to push the open-source frontier even as US labs focus on closed, agentic products.

items.title: Z.ai 称新模型在网络防御测试中逼近 Anthropic Mythos 5
items.summary: Reuters reported that Chinese lab Z.ai says its new model nears Anthropic's Mythos 5 in cyber-defence benchmarks. The claim underlines how AI safety and cyber-defense eval results are becoming a competitive talking point for labs in both the US and China.

items.title: AI 界人才流动：Transformer 联合发明人 Noam Shazeer 从 Google 转去 OpenAI
items.summary: Google's star AI researcher Noam Shazeer, a key figure behind the transformer architecture (the 'T' in GPT), left Google for OpenAI. This is his second major move between the two companies and reflects the ongoing talent war between the top AI labs.

items.title: Apple 与阿里巴巴合作，为中国市场训练专属 AI 模型
items.summary: Apple trained its own AI model for the Chinese market with help from Alibaba, Reuters and The Verge reported. The partnership lets Apple Intelligence run on-device in China while complying with local data and model requirements — a notable example of how AI product strategy must adapt to regional regulation.
items.tag: Apple · 阿里巴巴 · 中国市场

items.title: Nature 发表脑启发生成模型，可实现目标导向的想象与规划
items.summary: A new paper in Nature Machine Intelligence by Lin et al. introduces a brain-inspired generative model that enables goal-directed imagination and planning. The work connects cognitive-map ideas from neuroscience with modern generative AI — an example of how basic cognitive science continues to shape AI architecture research.
items.tag: 神经科学 · 规划 · 生成模型
